name: World Heavyweight Title
epitaph: RPW's World Heavyweight Title was first won by Gideon Poe on 11 January 2004. The fed's own record carries 3 reigns on it, across 3 different champions. The longest is Gideon Poe's, 98 days from 11 January 2004. Karina Wolfenden held it at the end of the surviving record.

name: Eclipse Title
epitaph: RPW's Eclipse Title was first won by Karina Wolfenden on 9 November 2003. The fed's own record carries 5 reigns on it, across 4 different champions. The longest is Ilan Levin's, 28 days from 23 November 2003. Gideon Poe held it at the end of the surviving record.

name: Tag Team Title
epitaph: RPW's Tag Team Title was first won by Invincible Gabe and Rampage, between 2004-03-14 and 2004-03-21. The fed's own record carries 2 reigns on it, across 2 different champions. The Forsaken held it at the end of the surviving record.

name: Mid South Title
epitaph: RPW's Mid South Title was first won by Chris Storm, before 2004-03-21. The fed's own record carries 3 reigns on it, across 3 different champions. Shawn Stewart held it at the end of the surviving record.
